Its separate sample SD uses n-1=2. Extra computed digits represent arithmetic, not improved measurement resolution. SD is discrete descriptive scatter, not a confidence interval or calibration uncertainty. Linear interpolation of the mean capacities is an authored approximation between measurements, without an interpolation-error bound or extrapolation. Native C_vol is independent of density normalization.

Divide mean native C_vol and its sample SD by the condition-mean density, then round each to whole J/(kg K). Published means are 1371,1439,1493,1553 and SD 18,30,23,24 at 10,20,30,40 degC. Density scatter, calibration and covariance are not propagated. Rounded Cp, native C_vol and normalization density are algebraically related, not independent experiments. Linear Cp interpolation is an authored model with no interpolation-error bound.
